title: AI & Machine Learning Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request deletion of your personal data from AI systems. Protect your privacy from ChatGPT and machine learning platforms.
description: A comprehensive letter template to help you request deletion, access, or correction of your personal data from AI and machine learning platforms. Includes specific language for ChatGPT, AI training data, and automated decision-making systems.

sections.heading: Letter Header and Contact Information
sections.content:
Date: [DATE]

To: Data Protection Officer / Privacy Team
[COMPANY_NAME]
[COMPANY_ADDRESS]

From: [YOUR_NAME]
[YOUR_ADDRESS]
[YOUR_EMAIL]
[YOUR_PHONE]

Subject: Data Privacy Request - Personal Information in AI/ML Systems

sections.heading: Request Introduction and Legal Basis
sections.content:
Dear Privacy Team,

I am writing to exercise my data protection rights regarding personal information that may be collected, processed, or stored by your AI and machine learning systems. Under applicable privacy laws including GDPR, CCPA, and other regional regulations, I request the following actions regarding my personal data:

[REQUEST_TYPE]

This request covers all personal information about me that may be:
• Used to train your AI models
• Stored from my interactions with AI chatbots
• Collected through automated data processing
• Used for AI-powered profiling or decision-making

placeholders.label: Type of Request
placeholders.defaultValue: □ Access to my data □ Deletion of my data □ Correction of my data □ Opt-out of AI training

sections.heading: Specific AI and ML Data Categories
sections.content:
Specifically, I request action regarding the following categories of personal data in your AI/ML systems:

1. **Conversation Data**: All chat logs, prompts, and responses from AI interactions
2. **Training Data**: Any personal information used to train language models or AI systems
3. **Behavioral Data**: Usage patterns, preferences, and interaction analytics
4. **Biometric Data**: Voice recordings, facial recognition data, or other biometric identifiers
5. **Inferred Data**: AI-generated profiles, predictions, or classifications about me
6. **Third-Party Data**: Information obtained from data brokers or partner companies

Please confirm whether you process any of these data types and take the requested action for each applicable category.

sections.heading: Account and Service Information
sections.content:
To help locate my data in your systems, please find my account details below:

Account Email: [ACCOUNT_EMAIL]
Username/ID: [USERNAME]
Account Creation Date: [CREATION_DATE]
Services Used: [SERVICES_USED]
Approximate Usage Period: [USAGE_PERIOD]

If you cannot locate my data using these details, please search using any combination of my contact information provided in this letter.

placeholders.label: Account Email Address
placeholders.defaultValue: Email used for AI service account

sections.heading: AI Training Data Opt-Out Request
sections.content:
I specifically request to opt-out of having my personal data used for AI model training purposes. This includes:

• Excluding my conversation history from future model training
• Removing my data from existing training datasets where technically feasible
• Ensuring my future interactions are not used for model improvement
• Providing confirmation of my opt-out status

Please provide details on your AI training opt-out process and confirm my exclusion from all current and future training activities.

sections.heading: Response Requirements and Timeline
sections.content:
Under applicable privacy laws, please respond to this request within the legally required timeframe (typically 30 days). Your response should include:

1. Confirmation of receipt of this request
2. Verification of my identity (if required)
3. Details of what personal data you hold about me
4. Confirmation of actions taken (deletion, correction, etc.)
5. Information about any data that cannot be deleted and why
6. Details of any third parties who may have received my data

If you need additional information to process this request, please contact me at [CONTACT_EMAIL] within 7 days.

sections.heading: Closing and Signature
sections.content:
I trust you will handle this request promptly and in accordance with applicable privacy laws. If you have any questions or require identity verification, please contact me using the information provided above.

I look forward to your response within the required timeframe. Please note that I am prepared to escalate this matter to relevant privacy authorities if my rights are not properly addressed.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,

[SIGNATURE]
[PRINTED_NAME]
[DATE]
